title: 第9章 乾坤造化丹脱胎换骨第10章 太初造化经
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
大萧皇朝众多惊才绝艳的天骄，最终都被卡在天人大圆满的境界，
犹如被一道无法逾越的天堑所阻挡，十几年，甚至上百年都难以寸进！就连想要领悟出一丝洞天的雏形，都如同痴人说梦，遥不可及。
为了区分天人境之间的细微差别，大陆上的武道强者们不得不另辟蹊径，单独划分出一个境界，名为半步洞天境。
这一境界，宛如一座高不可攀的山峰，只有那些领悟出一丝洞天雏形，却尚未参透洞天之秘的武道强者，才有资格攀登。
而真正的绝顶天骄，对此却不屑一顾。
她的脸上流露出无奈的落寞，如同一朵凋零的花朵，向自家的王爷萧凡拱了拱手，
轻声说道：“那个奴婢就先去办王爷您交代的事情了。”
以萧凡那敏锐的感知力，自然注意到了自己小侍女灵玉那失落的小表情。
然而，他并没有欺骗这个天真无邪的小丫头。
拥有系统这一外挂的他，帮助一个人突破境界，简直如同探囊取物般轻松。
他暗自盘算着，等弄到那种稀世珍宝，一定要给小丫头一个大大的惊喜！
看着小灵玉那如同黄莺出谷般的声音，萧凡的语气也变得格外柔和，“去吧！多注意一下安全，本王担心有人暗中耍阴谋诡计。”
毕竟，自从母亲离世后，小侍女灵玉就如同萧凡的影子一般，
时刻跟随在他身旁。
言罢，萧凡挥了挥手，仿佛在驱赶一只顽皮的蝴蝶似的。
小侍女灵玉发出一声细若蚊蝇的“嗯”了一声，
便如一阵风般急匆匆地跑出了萧凡的卧室。
……
萧凡在脑海中迅速梳理了一下当前自己面临的境况，
以及应对之策，确认没有任何疏漏之后，这才如释重负地返回到自己那柔软舒适的大床上，

静候事件的发展！
不过，他深知自己的修炼也不能有丝毫松懈，
正好之前系统的新手大礼包赠送了一部崭新的功法和一枚神秘莫测的丹药，
其功效甚至超越了这方世界那传说中的神级功法和丹药。
content_en:
Many talented and talented geniuses in the Great Xiao Dynasty were eventually stuck in the realm of perfection between heaven and man.
It's like being blocked by an insurmountable natural chasm, making it difficult to make any progress for more than ten years, or even hundreds of years! Even trying to understand the rudiment of the cave is like a dream, out of reach.
In order to distinguish the subtle differences between the realms of heaven and humans, the martial arts masters on the mainland had to find another way to create a separate realm called the Half-Step Cave Heaven Realm.
This realm is like an unreachable mountain. Only those martial arts masters who have understood the rudiments of the cave but have not yet penetrated the secrets of the cave are qualified to climb.
But the real genius is disdainful of this.
Her face showed helpless loneliness, like a withered flower, and she bowed her hand to her prince Xiao Fan.
He said softly: "That slave will go and do the things that the prince has asked you to do first."
With Xiao Fan's keen perception, he naturally noticed the disappointed expression of his little maid Lingyu.
However, he did not deceive this innocent little girl.
With the plug-in of the system, he can help a person break through the realm as easily as searching for something.
He secretly planned that when he got that kind of rare treasure, he would definitely give the little girl a big surprise!
Looking at Xiao Lingyu's voice, which was like an oriole coming out of the valley, Xiao Fan's tone became particularly soft, "Go! Pay more attention to safety, I am worried that someone is secretly playing tricks."
After all, since her mother passed away, the little maid Lingyu has been like Xiao Fan's shadow.
Follow him at all times.
After saying this, Xiao Fan waved his hand, as if he was driving away a naughty butterfly.
The little maid Lingyu made a sound as thin as a mosquito's fly, "Hmm".
He hurried out of Xiao Fan's bedroom like a gust of wind.
…
Xiao Fan quickly sorted out the current situation he was facing in his mind.
and countermeasures, and after confirming that there were no omissions, he returned to his soft and comfortable big bed with relief.
Waiting for the development of events!
However, he knew that he could not relax in his cultivation at all.
It just so happened that the system's newbie gift package gave away a brand new skill and a mysterious elixir.
Its efficacy even surpasses the legendary god-level techniques and elixirs in this world.
